systems.tiers: national, provincial, district and school levels named as holding staff responsible for data; school-level collection described as largely paper-based

note: The document names an 'established EMIS' with 'multiple education data subsystems' and 'electronic data platforms' but never says what the EMIS holds or whether schools add per-learner records, so it is unclassified and gives no fact. It does state, from a KIX assessment in Maputo on 3-4 August 2026, that much of the data collected at school level is still paper-based with manual data entry, and that expanding electronic, decentralised data entry was set as a priority at a national dialogue on 5-7 August 2026.
